description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying prayer times, handling user interactions such as viewing prayer history and Qibla directions, managing prayer checklist status, updating UI headers, and integrating with device sensors for compass directions. It also manages background tasks such as periodic UI updates and scheduling prayer notifications.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages the home screen UI, displaying prayer times, handling user interactions, managing device sensors for compass directions, and scheduling notifications.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's views, sets up click listeners, binds checkbox states, and initializes sensor managers.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches prayer times and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateHeader
methods.description: Updates the header with current date and time.

methods.name: updateNextPrayer
methods.description: Determines and displays the next upcoming prayer time based on current time.

methods.name: maybeScheduleNotifications
methods.description: Schedules prayer notifications if enabled in preferences.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts UI updates and sensor listening when the fragment becomes active.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops UI updates and sensor listening when the fragment is no longer active.
